---
title: "Notes"
subtitle: "Notes on statistics, machine learning, and genetics."
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default          # try 'grid' or 'table' for other looks
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  fields: [title, date]  # keep each entry minimal — no author, tags, or description
  feed: true             # generates notes.xml (RSS) — linked in the navbar
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
---

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // Move the auto-generated category list out of the margin sidebar and
  // place it as a horizontal row directly beneath the page subtitle.
  var cats = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category");
  var titleBlock = document.querySelector("#title-block-header .quarto-title");
  if (cats && titleBlock) {
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "posts-categories";
    wrap.appendChild(cats);
    titleBlock.appendChild(wrap);
  }
  var catTitle = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category-title");
  if (catTitle) catTitle.remove();
});
</script>
```
